project.title: DeMix:efficient identification of co-fragmented peptides
project.projectDescription: A data analysis workflow with a simple deconvolution method based on high resolution data-dependent tandem mass spectrometry.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: HeLa cell lysate trypsin digestion. SDC. 150min LC-MS/MS with 2h non-linear gradient. Top-20 DDA.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: OpenMS, peak centroiding, feature detection ProteoWizard, format convertion Morpheus, database searching MaxQuant/Mascot/MS-GF+  search engines for comparative analysis.
